About

Ferrand

DJ · Producer

Trance
Bounce
Hard House
Hard Dance

There are producers who wait for the right moment — and then there's Ferrand. The Cologne-based DJ and producer is one of the most compelling names to emerge from Europe's trance bounce and hard dance underground: raw, euphoric and built entirely on his own terms.

He started where most artists only dream of breaking through — self-released SoundCloud edits, no label backing, no industry shortcuts. Track by track, the plays stacked up into the hundreds of thousands, and a loyal following formed around a sound that felt both nostalgic and urgently current: the grittiness of oldschool hard house, the euphoria of 90s eurodance, all rewired for modern rave floors.

His records have since landed on the radars of some of the scene's most respected selectors — picked up by Marlon Hoffstadt, KiKi, Armin van Buuren, Hannah Laing, Mischluft, 2Hot2Play and many more, and dropped in peak-time slots at clubs and festivals across Europe, including ADE showcases.

Behind the decks, Ferrand understands something most DJs don't: that the drop only hits as hard as the build before it. Sets at Lokschuppen Berlin, Grelle Forelle Vienna, Odonien and Artheater Cologne aren't just peak-time assaults — they're carefully constructed journeys, moments of tension and release that leave a room breathless precisely because they knew when to breathe.
